title: 源码索引：内容身份、代际取消与显式追赶
sourceScope: 完整Core产品库存，变化时保守要求重验

cases.title: SourceGraphIndexer detects equal-size content changes with preserved mtime and still noops for metadata-only touches
SourceGraphIndexer uses one source text for SDK symbols and hashes even when the live file changes after the read
SourceGraphIndexer does not publish a generation when the build is cancelled before publication
SourceGraphIndexer detects stale filesystem changes and builds an incremental generation with deletion cleanup
SourceGraphIndexer records partial and degraded accounting for large, unsupported, timeout, and parse-failed files
Atlas Core recovery probe cancelled source generation can recover with a new signal and exact content hash
